allow_instructions: Allow read-only shell commands: git status, git diff, git log, dir, ls, rg, grep, head, tail, type, Get-ChildItem, Get-Content, Select-String.
Allow Unity EditMode batch tests for MyriadOfDragonsUnity when Unity Editor is closed.
Allow copying project docs to the owner's Google Drive WIP folder under card game/Game mech/MOD/Phase 1/Game mech/WIP.
Allow robocopy or Copy-Item mirroring UI assets from Assets/Resources to Drive UnityReviewMirror for PM review only.
Allow npm/dotnet build or test commands inside this workspace when the user asked for execution or CI.
block_instructions: Block git push --force, git reset --hard, git clean -fd, and any command that deletes the Unity project or Drive backups.
Block editing frozen Save files (PlayerProfile, SaveMigration, SaveSystem) without explicit user approval in the same turn.
Block network calls except package managers, Unity Hub, GitHub, and Google Drive sync paths the user uses.
